name: Jira
description: Jira Cloud REST v3 native tools (14 methods, each is a named tool). Generic: jira_search / jira_get / jira_list_comments / jira_get_comment / jira_comment / jira_list_attachments / jira_get_attachment / jira_upload_attachment / jira_transition. Orchestrator: jira_create_task / jira_create_subtask / jira_submit_verdict / jira_abandon_task / jira_request_help. Resolution is env-first (CP-2955): JIRA_ATST_TOKEN (or legacy ATST_TOKEN) + JIRA_CLOUD_ID (+ optional JIRA_PROXY); openclaw.json config is a last-resort fallback. See skills/jira/SKILL.md for per-tool guidance.

atstToken.description: (optional, last-resort fallback) Override JIRA_ATST_TOKEN env var (preferred name; legacy ATST_TOKEN also accepted)

cloudId.description: (optional, last-resort fallback) Override JIRA_CLOUD_ID env var

proxy.description: (optional, last-resort fallback) Override JIRA_PROXY env var
